A wholesale catalogue site for a client with 200+ products, managed by the client through Google Sheets.

## Overview
A live catalogue for a wholesale plastics business. It is built with vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript on purpose, so it stays fast, cheap to run and deploys to Vercel with a single push.

## What it does
- Lists 200+ products with global search and a dark mode.
- Google Sheets and Drive act as the data layer, so the client updates products without a developer.
- A 6-page Apps Script admin panel handles product management.
- An automated backup runs every 2 days.

Evaluates handwritten answer sheets with OCR and semantic similarity, in about 30 seconds per sheet.

## Overview
A Streamlit app that reads handwritten answers with Tesseract OCR and scores them against reference answers using Sentence-BERT.

## Results
- Tested on 50+ handwritten sheets, 5 to 10 questions each.
- About 80 to 90% accuracy on clearly written answers.
- About 30 seconds per sheet, against 2 to 3 minutes by hand.
- Generates scores and a CSV report automatically.
